quarterly_data.quarter: Applied Digital press release: Applied Digital Brings an Additional 75 MW of AI (10-02-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Applied Digital achieved Ready for Service for the second phase of Building 2 at its Polaris Forge 1 campus (Ellendale, North Dakota), delivering an additional 75 MW of critical IT load across three 25 MW data halls. This completes Building 2's full 150 MW and brings fully operational critical IT load at Polaris Forge 1 to 250 MW, following the first 100 MW building and the initial 75 MW phase of Building 2; the fully leased campus is contracted to deliver 400 MW of critical IT load at full buildout. CEO Wes Cummins: 'Securing power is only the starting point. The real work is designing, building, commissioning, and operating the infrastructure that transforms those megawatts into usable capacity for customers.'
quarterly_data.figure: additional 75 MW (three 25 MW data halls); Polaris Forge 1 operational critical IT load 250 MW of 400 MW contracted
